# Junk A Car

> Junk A Car is an AMVIC licensed Alberta vehicle buyer based in Calgary. We buy junk, scrap, damaged, written-off, fleet and non-running vehicles, provide free towing, and pay by cash or e-transfer at collection.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.junkacar.ca/
- Phone: +1-403-688-7307
- Email: info@junkacar.ca
- Address: 6915 40 St NE, Calgary, AB T3J 4H2, Canada
- Hours: Daily, 7:00 am–11:00 pm

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.junkacar.ca/): Cash for junk cars in Calgary and Alberta.
- [About Us](https://www.junkacar.ca/about): Company history, licensing, pricing and recycling practices.
- [How It Works](https://www.junkacar.ca/how-it-works): Quote, booking, pickup, payment and Alberta paperwork.
- [What We Buy](https://www.junkacar.ca/what-we-buy): Accepted vehicle types, conditions and ownership situations.
- [FAQ](https://www.junkacar.ca/faq): Pricing, paperwork, ownership and towing answers.
- [Contact](https://www.junkacar.ca/contact): Phone, email, hours, address and cash-offer form.

## Business facts

- Established: 1998
- Volume: More than 500 vehicles purchased monthly
- Payment: Cash or e-transfer before loading
- Towing: Free throughout listed service areas
- Vehicle condition: Running or non-running; damaged, written-off, stripped and end-of-life vehicles accepted with proof of ownership
- Canonical host: https://www.junkacar.ca
